name: God's Gift
summary: **God's Gift** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] cross of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[granddaddy-purple|Granddaddy Purple]] that emerged in California dispensary circles in the mid-2000s. No formal breeder is credited, and it spread first as a clone-only cut before commercial seed lines appeared. The cross produces indica-dominant, deep-purple plants.
